scope: For all integers 1<=d<n, D(n,d) has arcs x->x+j (mod n), 1<=j<=d. Write n=qd+r with 2<=r<=d+1. Then gp=d+1 for r=d+1, and gp=max(r,floor(d/r)+1) otherwise. This is the original unnumbered optimality assertion after Theorem 3.3 in [arXiv:2604.15909v1](https://arxiv.org/html/2604.15909v1#S3.SS1).
